build_DETR_model: build a DETR object detection model with backbone, transformer, and configurable number of queries
run_DETR_forward: run the DETR forward pass on a NestedTensor of batched images to get predictions
create_PostProcess: create a PostProcess module to convert DETR output logits and boxes to COCO API format
create_MLP: create a multi-layer perceptron with configurable input, hidden, output dimensions and layer count
build_DETR_criterion: build the full DETR pipeline including model, SetCriterion loss, and postprocessors from args
